items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I want to know more about Blonde Charlie. That's a guy I don't know much about. Who did he work with? [INTERVIEWEE] He always worked with a short man. And he worked more in the thunk and cabaret. He's a pretty good clarinets player.

ctx.x: Two clarins, two trumpets, sometimes two pianos. Not two pianos, but two mandolin pianos. All musicians, Sineviché, myself, and how they call them, Red, Red Island, Robert Taylor, all school musicians. Don Emanuel, Pickles, Teal, Rocky. Oh man, I couldn't call him anymore. I think for now, I know a lot of my twain. All them boys would be on there.
I want to know more about Blonde Charlie. That's a guy I don't know much about. Who did he work with?
He always worked with a short man. And he worked more in the thunk and cabaret. He's a pretty good clarinets player. He played blues? Oh yeah.
